description:
Three small concerns that share a commit (port-map §6, §7, telemetry
comment on octo-z1d epic):

1. Hooks (§6):
   - before_tool_call: (ctx -> {:block, reason} | :allow)
   - after_tool_call:  (ctx -> {:patch, map()} | :unchanged)
   Plumbed through session opts, invoked by tool_dispatch around
   each tool. Exceptions caught → synthetic error result.

2. Subscribers (§7):
   OctoPi.Agent.Subscribers module using Registry.
   - subscribe(session, pid, mode) :: {:ok, unsubscribe_fn}
   - dispatch(session, event) iterates subscribers; :sync uses
     GenServer.call with 5s timeout, :async uses send.
   - A timeout on a :sync listener logs a warning + continues.

3. Telemetry:
   - Handler module OctoPi.Telemetry.AgentHandler in octo_pi_agent.
   - Events (per opi-hgb.6 convention: first segment = emitting app):
       [:octo_pi_agent, :session, :start]
       [:octo_pi_agent, :session, :stop]
       [:octo_pi_agent, :turn, :start]
       [:octo_pi_agent, :turn, :stop]
       [:octo_pi_agent, :turn, :exception]
       [:octo_pi_agent, :tool, :start]
       [:octo_pi_agent, :tool, :stop]
       [:octo_pi_agent, :tool, :error]
   - Uses OctoPi.Telemetry.Logger.attach/2 helper from opi-hgb.6.
   - Emission sites in loop + tool_dispatch.

TDD:
- Hook block/patch semantics
- Subscriber registration order; :sync barrier; :async fire-and-forget
- Telemetry emissions with expected metadata

Depends on z1d.3, z1d.4.
title: Hooks + subscribers + telemetry (per-app handler + event names)
